subject: Investigate: spike in 5xx/429 + retry loop after model v3.1 quantized rollout
messages:
From: Luis Vega <luis.vega@novapay.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-22 09:12 -0800
Subject: Production errors rolling out model v3.1 (URGENT)

Soojin —

We started the v3.1 quantized model rollout to our production traffic at 08:45 PT and immediately saw a surge in 5xx/429 responses. Our logs show repeated client retries that drove a retry storm and subsequent timeouts across multiple endpoints. Latency percentiles spiked (P95 -> 2.3s, P99 -> 7.8s) and error rate increased to ~11% within 15 minutes.

Can your team pause the rollout and share any known incompatibilities with the v3.1 quantization profile or kernel mappings? We've attached a sample of request traces and the retry traces. We are getting pushback from our engineering and ops leadership — they want this fixed ASAP or rolled back.

Please escalate to whoever owns serving runtime kernels — this looks model-specific (errors reference kv_cache mismatch in the logs).

— Luis
Director of Platform Engineering, NovaPay
attachments: llm-inference-logs-20261122.zip, retry-trace.txt
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-22 09:28 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Production errors rolling out model v3.1 (URGENT)

Marissa / Jonas — forwarding an urgent customer escalation from NovaPay. They started receiving v3.1 traffic and are seeing a retry storm causing 5xx/429 and timeouts.

Key symptoms from their traces:
- Rapid increase in 429s and 5xx immediately after enabling v3.1 quantized profile.
- Logs reference kernel dispatch errors + kv_cache validation failures.
- Client retries amplified load (retry storm) -> tail latency blowup.

Ask: can we halt the automated rollout for v3.1 in region us-west-2 for NovaPay and push an emergency rollback to the previous non-quantized variant (v3.0)? If rollout cannot be paused immediately, we need a mitigation plan (throttle, per-customer rate cap, or immediate fallback to model v2/v3.0).

I attached their logs. Please reply with next steps and ETA. I'm prepared to escalate to Hannah for exec attention if needed.

— Soojin
Sr. Customer Success, Redwood Inference
attachments: llm-inference-logs-20261122.zip
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-22 09:42 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production errors rolling out model v3.1 (URGENT)

On 11/22/26 09:28, soojin_lee@redwood.com wrote:
> Key symptoms from their traces:
> - Rapid increase in 429s and 5xx immediately after enabling v3.1 quantized profile.
> - Logs reference kernel dispatch errors + kv_cache validation failures.
> - Client retries amplified load (retry storm) -> tail latency blowup.

We can — and should — pause the rollout. I've triggered a hold on the v3.1 staged rollout for NovaPay in the control plane (policy: pause-by-customer). We also pushed a canary rollback to v3.0 for their reserved pool and started a soft throttle at the routing layer to 70% of baseline QPS to reduce retries.

Immediate next steps I'm executing now (ETA in parentheses):
1) Confirm rollback completion for all instances in us-west-2 (10 min)
2) Collect server-side kernel logs and quantization mismatch traces (15 min)
3) Short-term routing throttle and per-customer rate limit until root cause identified (5 min)
4) If kernel mismatch confirmed, patch rollout to gate the quantized kernel mapping for v3.1 only to supported hardware (30-60 min)

Jonas — can you take point on kernel/runner logs? I suspect a kernel selection regression with the new quant profile causing misaligned buffer sizes and subsequent kv_cache hits to fail. Capture the histogram for allocation failures and map to host kernel versions.

I'll keep NovaPay updated. If we confirm this is model-specific and reproducible, we should loop in Engineering leadership for a postmortem and potential customer credit.

— Marissa
Head of Reliability, Redwood Inference
attachments: kernel-profiles.csv
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-22 10:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production errors rolling out model v3.1 (URGENT)

On 11/22/26 09:42, marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:
> Jonas — can you take point on kernel/runner logs? I suspect a kernel selection regression with the new quant profile causing misaligned buffer sizes and subsequent kv_cache hits to fail.

Quick update from the runtime triage: we see an increase in kernel fallback paths that weren't exercised in previous builds. The quantization profile changed the tensor packing layout for certain attention kernels; older kernels attempt an in-place op that fails an alignment check on a subset of cards. When the kernel fails, the runner returns a 5xx and the request is retried by client-side logic — created a retry amplification loop.

Actions completed:
- Forced the control plane to prefer conservative kernel mapping for v3.1 (revert to prior mapping) for NovaPay's pool (done).
- Rolled back NovaPay's reservation to v3.0 instances (monitoring shows error rate dropping to ~0.7% over last 6 minutes).
- Collected stack traces and created a minimal reproducer that exercises the alignment check (attached).

We will need an urgent patch to the kernel selector that verifies alignment/skips in-place ops when quant layout differs, plus a test in CI that runs v3.1 quant profiles against the older cards. Est ETA for patch + test: 4-6 hours (assuming no infra blockers).

I'll prepare a short incident summary for Hannah for exec visibility.

— Jonas
Principal Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: retry-trace.txt, kernel-reproducer.log
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-22 13:05 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Production errors rolling out model v3.1 (URGENT) — Exec note + customer comms

Thanks everyone for the rapid response and clear next steps. Short executive brief for NovaPay leadership:

Summary:
- Incident: Elevated 5xx/429 and timeout rates for NovaPay after enabling model v3.1 quantized profile; retry amplification worsened impact.
- Impact window: 08:45 PT -> 09:20 PT (primary); residual elevated latency during rollback period.
- Root cause (preliminary): Kernel selector regression + quant layout mismatch causing alignment failures on a subset of GPUs; led to kernel fallback + 5xx responses and client retries.
- Customer status: Rollback to v3.0 completed; current error rate ~0.6% and tail latency receding.

Immediate remediation items (owners):
- Patch kernel selector to add quant-layout alignment check (Jonas, 4-6h).
- Add integration test for v3.1 quant profile on older kernel builds (Marissa/Jonas, 6-8h).
- Customer communication: Soojin to send a concise incident note and offer 2 weeks of support credits as a gesture (So that we can preserve relationship).
- Postmortem and release gating: schedule with Eng leadership and Product to update rollout gating for quantized variants (Hannah).

Soojin — please send the customer note (short + technical summary + next steps) and include the rollback confirmation and our timeline for the patch. I'll draft the executive summary for the account team and Finance for any credits.

— Hannah
VP, Customer Success & Operations, Redwood Inference
